arm_probe.publication: ARM clears and populates the header, releases, then writes magic last.

checks.name: clean_reset_attachment
checks.procedure: Load the RBF, then initialize the ARM control page.

checks.name: malformed_magic
checks.procedure: Prepare a malformed control page, load the RBF, then observe the FPGA state without changing the page.

checks.name: stale_frame_slot
checks.procedure: Prepare a stale frame-slot generation, load the RBF, then observe the FPGA state without changing the page.

checks.name: clean_state_restored
checks.procedure: Reload the RBF and initialize a valid page after both fault checks.

race_fix.issue: A reset-time retry could overwrite the ARM-owned component state while the ARM was publishing a new header.
race_fix.resolution: FPGA state writes use only the upper four byte lanes of the shared status word (ddram_be=0xf0); ARM owns the lower four byte lanes.
race_fix.hardware_result: The clean reset-time attachment passes with the corrected RBF.

scope_limit: This validates control-page discovery and fault handling. Native test-pattern scanout remains active; actual frame-slot transfer, vblank ownership, game launch, input, audio and performance qualification remain open.
